description: This file defines the 'EmailConfigurationService' class responsible for managing email configuration operations within the OrangeHRM HRM system, including retrieving DAO and service instances, setting dependencies, and sending test emails.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class for handling email configuration related functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationDao
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of EmailConfigurationDao, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of EmailService, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: setEmailService
methods.description: Sets the EmailService dependency for this service.

methods.name: sendTestMail
methods.description: Sends a test email using the EmailService.
